page.notes: Gutter line numbers 10 to 60 placed in the nearest paragraph; their exact vertical placement is approximate. Left-column list has no printed indents, so it is one paragraph running over the column break. "Vuit-tenbergenses" hyphenation is inferred from the line end. The first word "florem" is doubtful (rendered [?]). The last line is cut off at the foot of the page and is partly illegible. The right-column entries marked with * and + are printed symbols and are kept as printed. Page number 488 is printed on the left page only.
